fields.description: Valo combines 285 apartments with six three-bedroom townhouses in Dubai Creek Harbour’s Creek Beach district. The apartments offer one to three bedrooms, while the townhouses span two podium levels. A shared amenities podium brings pools, gardens and fitness spaces together, with the waterfront and neighbourhood plaza forming part of the wider setting.

overview: Valo’s architecture uses shaded balconies and locally sourced materials within a contemporary waterfront setting. The brochure sets out practical environmental measures including insulated roofs, double glazing, condensate reuse for irrigation and energy-saving lighting. EV charging and bicycle parking are included in the design programme. Confirm the delivered specification and allocation of these facilities for the chosen home.
research.locationNote: The development sits near the main plaza in the Creek Beach district. Emaar identifies Creek Marina, Harbour Promenade, Central Park and the Viewing Point as nearby destinations. Canal, park and skyline views vary by apartment. Check current road routes and the delivery status of advertised metro and water-transport connections separately.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s available-unit section shows AED 2,900,888; the same page retains a starting headline of AED 1.79m. The April 2024 fact sheet lists launches from AED 1.79m, 2.4m and 4.13m for apartments with one, two and three bedrooms, and AED 4.86m for townhouses. Property Finder shows a higher headline. These are differing dated offers, not a current price guarantee.
research.paymentNote: The original plan totals 90% before completion and 10% at estimated completion. September 2025 and February 2028 carry 5% each; the remaining nine stages are 10% each. This is a historical construction-linked schedule. Confirm paid amounts, remaining instalments and any revised terms for the selected unit.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document estimates September 2028 completion, also reported by Property Finder. Confirm the current programme and contractual possession terms with the developer.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: 291 homes comprise 285 apartments and six townhouses. These are launch totals and do not indicate today’s available inventory.

facts.label: Shared recreation
facts.value: The official page and fact sheet describe a 6,000 sq m amenities podium, combining active and quieter uses. Confirm opening dates, maintenance arrangements and any usage rules before relying on specific facilities.

facts.label: Townhouse layout
facts.value: The three-bedroom townhouses occupy podium levels 1 and 2. The reviewed plan places one bedroom, a maid’s room, laundry and living/dining space downstairs, with two bedrooms upstairs. All six show 1,956.34 sq ft of suite area; balcony differences account for their varying totals.

facts.label: Comparing apartment sizes
facts.value: Totals include balconies. Three-bedroom apartment drawings range from 1,785.95 to 1,876.36 sq ft; the approximately 2,041–2,048 sq ft homes are townhouses, not standard apartments. Use the exact approved plan rather than rounded portal ranges.
